dragHint: Drag a figure or the empty space (the camera); the wheel moves the camera in and out. Your move goes into the chat for the agent.
waiting: Moved here: in the chat for the agent
notStarted: This shot did not start: ask the agent to look at it.
copied: Copied: paste it into your agent's chat
emptyHint: Describe a shot in the chat, for example: "a small room, she comes in through the back door and walks to the window, the camera pushing in from wide to medium". The agent builds it here.
noShots: Shots the agent makes show here.
made: On the canvas: pick a model and press Make
